scenario: An `after` body reading a parent-rule LHS binding, `{m.entity_id}`, compiles, so the binding is in scope there. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowered output, so LTAC.3.5's `$CaptureBindings_<rule>_after_0` fact and the follow-up rule's join are not observed.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule auto_off:
    Motion m
->
    log info "on"
    after 5_min:
        log info "off: {m.entity_id}"
